description_en: Queries administrator operation audit logs in batches
description_zh: 批量查询管理员操作审计日志
name: ListOperationAuditLogs

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. This value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds. The value must be earlier than EndTime. The interval between StartTime and EndTime cannot exceed 30 days, and StartTime cannot be more than 31 days before the current time
parameters.help_zh: 查询的起始时间，秒级Unix时间戳。取值必须小于EndTime，与EndTime的间隔不超过30天，且距当前时间不超过31天
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. This value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds. The value must be later than StartTime
parameters.help_zh: 查询的结束时间，秒级Unix时间戳。取值必须大于StartTime
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page in paging. The value starts from 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时显示的当前页的页码。起始值为1
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Settings: 1 to 100. Used in paging
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页数量。取值：1~100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The event source type. Valid values:
console: console call.
sdk: SDK call
parameters.help_zh:
事件来源类型。取值：
console：控制台调用。
sdk：SDK调用
parameters.name: event_type

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID (AliUid) of the operator
parameters.name: operator_id

parameters.help_en:
The operation function module. The value is the English code of the function module. If other values are specified, no records are returned. Valid values:
PrivateAccess: private access.
OfficeNetworkAccess: office network access.
AppAcceleration: application acceleration.
InternetAccess: Internet access.
OfficeDataProtection: office data protection.
IdentityAccessManagement: identity and access management.
DeviceManagement: device management.
ApprovalCenter: approval center.
SoftwareManagement: software management.
LogAnalysis: log analysis.
Setting: settings.
DigitalWatermark: digital watermarking.
DynamicDecision: dynamic decision.
InternetBehaviorManagement: Internet behavior management.
AgentOfficeSecurity: Agent office security.
NetworkAccess: network access.
RiskManagement: risk management.
EndpointProtection: endpoint protection.
Overview: overview page.
ITManagement: IT management.
InstanceManagement: instance management
parameters.help_zh:
操作功能模块。取值为功能模块的英文编码，传入其他值将查询不到任何记录。取值：
PrivateAccess：内网访问。
OfficeNetworkAccess：办公网准入。
AppAcceleration：应用加速。
InternetAccess：互联网访问。
OfficeDataProtection：办公数据保护。
IdentityAccessManagement：身份认证管理。
DeviceManagement：终端管理。
ApprovalCenter：审批中心。
SoftwareManagement：软件管理。
LogAnalysis：日志分析。
Setting：设置。
DigitalWatermark：数字水印。
DynamicDecision：动态决策。
InternetBehaviorManagement：上网行为管理。
AgentOfficeSecurity：Agent办公安全。
NetworkAccess：网络准入。
RiskManagement：风险管理。
EndpointProtection：终端防护。
Overview：概览页。
ITManagement：IT管理。
InstanceManagement：实例管理
parameters.name: operation_func

parameters.help_en: The operation type. The value must exactly match the original operation type recorded in the log. The OperationType value in the response is localized based on the request language and may differ from this filter value
parameters.help_zh: 操作类型。取值需与日志中记录的原始操作类型完全一致；返回结果中的OperationType已按请求语言本地化，与该筛选值可能不同
parameters.name: operation_type

parameters.help_en:
The operation status. Valid values:
success: The operation succeeded. Equivalent values: true, 成功.
failure: The operation failed. Equivalent values: fail, failed, false, 失败.

If this parameter is not specified, only successful operation records are returned
parameters.help_zh:
操作状态。取值：
success：成功，等价取值为true、成功。
failure：失败，等价取值为fail、failed、false、失败。

不传时仅返回操作成功的记录
parameters.name: operation_status

Logs.description_en: The list of administrator operation audit logs, sorted by operation time in descending order
Logs.description_zh: 管理员操作审计日志列表，按操作时间倒序排列

AfterAction.description_en: The post-operation snapshot. This value is recorded as-is by the audit framework without localization. This field is empty for historical logs that are not integrated with the audit framework
AfterAction.description_zh: 操作后快照，由审计框架原样记录，不做本地化处理。未接入审计框架的历史日志该字段为空

BeforeAction.description_en: The pre-operation snapshot. This value is recorded as-is by the audit framework without localization. This field is empty for historical logs that are not integrated with the audit framework
BeforeAction.description_zh: 操作前快照，由审计框架原样记录，不做本地化处理。未接入审计框架的历史日志该字段为空

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code when the operation failed. This field is empty when the operation succeeded
ErrorCode.description_zh: 操作失败时的错误码。操作成功时为空

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message when the operation failed. This field is empty when the operation succeeded
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 操作失败时的错误信息。操作成功时为空
ErrorMessage.example: the specified resource is not found

OperationFunc.description_en: The operation function module. The return value is localized based on the request language
OperationFunc.description_zh: 操作功能模块。返回值已按请求语言本地化

OperationPage.description_en: The operation page. The return value is localized based on the request language
OperationPage.description_zh: 操作页面。返回值已按请求语言本地化

OperationType.description_en: The operation type. The return value is localized based on the request language
OperationType.description_zh: 操作类型。返回值已按请求语言本地化

OperatorId.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID (AliUid) of the operator

TotalNum.description_en: The total number of logs that match the query conditions
TotalNum.description_zh: 符合查询条件的日志总数
